_description: Image Validation Stage - Step 2 of the FaceMed AI Pipeline

blurDetection.description: If the variance of the Laplacian filter applied to the image is below the threshold, the image is considered too blurry.
blurDetection.rejectMessage: Image is too blurry. Please upload a sharper photo.

resolutionCheck.description: Image must be at least 100x100 pixels to ensure enough detail for skin analysis.
resolutionCheck.rejectMessage: Image resolution too low. Minimum required: 100x100 pixels.

faceDetection.description: Uses TensorFlow.js Face Detection API to verify a human face is present in the image.
faceDetection.rejectMessage: No face detected. Please upload a clear frontal face photo.

lightingCheck.description: Average pixel luminance must fall within acceptable range. Too dark or overexposed images are rejected.
lightingCheck.rejectMessage: Image lighting is too dark or overexposed. Please use natural light.
